title: Spacious 2BR Rosemary Beach Rental with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Relax at Savannah 1E, a luxury 2BR, 2.5BA Rosemary Beach condo, 3 minutes from the beach, with a private terrace, private beach & pool access. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: DescriptionNamed for the gracious southern city, the Savannah Building is an elegant and luxurious property tucked into the hub of Rosemary Beach and surrounded by charming cobblestone streets, quaint shops, and delicious cafes. Savannah 1E is a quintessential 30A condominium with an unmistakable luxe, beachy vibe. Your family will be close to nearly everything while being tucked serenely above it all in pure comfort and privacy. This spacious two-bedroom unit has sleeping space for six people.The open living and dining areas have a classic style filled with comfy, chic details. Two over-stuffed sofas and two refined armchairs face a built-in bookshelf housing a flatscreen television. Nearby, the dining area has a farmhouse-style dining table with seating for six and a fireplace. The kitchen is wide open to the living area, ideal for families. An L-shaped island is topped with gleaming marble and has additional casual bar seating for three. Glass French doors lead out to the sun-kissed terrace.There’s sleeping space for six people at Savannah 1E, spread out over two master suites and an additional bunk berth. The first master suite has a king-size bed dressed in crisp white linen and faces a flatscreen television. A unique sunroom has built-in bench seating. You’ll find a spa-like, glass-enclosed shower and double vanity in the en suite bathroom. The second master suite also has a king-size bed and flatscreen television. The attached bathroom has a glass-enclosed shower and rustic wood vanity. A twin-over-twin-size bunk bed sleeping berth is built into the hallway and will be a huge hit with kids of all ages.In the morning, take your steaming mug of fresh coffee out to your private terrace and watch the pastel sunset light up the sky. In the evenings, host a twilight happy hour on the patio while the sun goes down. It’s a lovely spot to soak up the sun, relax in the shade, take in the show-stopping views, feel the gentle sea breeze, and watch the hustle and bustle of Rosemary Beach below.When you’re ready for adventure, all of the magic of Scenic Highway 30A is right outside your door at Savannah 1E. The Gulf of Mexico's sandy beach and turquoise water are about a 3-minute walk away. The sparkling Barbados and Coquina pools are each a 5-minute stroll from your door. Award-winning golf courses and tennis facilities are close by. And, of course, delicious dining, casual cafes, and endless shopping are right around the corner. Rosemary beach is also home to many common green areas— including playgrounds, a splash pad, a butterfly park, and tranquil fountains. There’s also a state-of-the-art fitness center offering massage and yoga. Simply put, Savannah 1E in Rosemary Beach has it all.HOME HIGHLIGHTS* 2 Min Walk to the Beach* Complete Clean Bedding Program* 1 Assigned Parking Space* Very family-friendly atmosphere* A spacious, sunny terrace with gulf views* In the heart of downtown Rosemary beach* Access to 4 private community pools* 4 Beach Cruiser Bikes ProvidedMAIN FLOOR - 3rd Floor Unit* Sunny private terrace with gulf views and Outdoor seating for 4* Living room with two sofas, 2 side chairs, side table, coffee table, bookshelves, lamps, flat-screen TV* Kitchen with marble counters, stainless steel appliances, L-shaped island with seating for 3* Indoor dining area with seating for 6* Half Bath Powder Room* First MASTER BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, lamps, flatscreen television, sunroom, and access to the terrace* EN-SUITE BATHROOM with walk-in shower* Second MASTER BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, lamps, flatscreen television, and access to the outdoor terrace* EN-SUITE BATHROOM with step-in shower* SLEEPING BERTH with two twin-over-twin-size bunks
